verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm reusable components that work across files [penpot-docs-11]. Copies stay linked so that updates to the main component flow to them, and a copy can restore a deleted main [penpot-docs-22, penpot-docs-23]. Variants are a documented design-system feature [penpot-docs-41]. Community remarks that variants lag Figma and that components feel difficult to handle are general sentiment, not concrete failures. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-instance overrides being preserved while linked, in-depth variant docs, independent hands-on corroboration of variants/override behavior.
